in_marathi.name: Premjit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Precious, dear one
in_marathi.long_meaning: Premjit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prem means precious or dear, and Jit means victory or achievement. The name Premjit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prem' which means love. The name signifies that the person is a precious one, who has achieved victory in life through love.
